links.comparator_used: GPT4oTranscribe alone (uncorrected ASR transcript), not clinician self-review
links.outcome: Domain word error rate (DWER) and WER of transcribed orthodontic clinical records
links.effect: GPT4oTranscribeCorrected DWER = 3.5%, WER = 3.7%; DWER decreased by 54.9% versus GPT4oTranscribe. It was also the only system whose DWER was not higher than N-DWER, and it performed best on lexical and semantic scores.
links.tradeoff: Clinically significant errors persisted even with LLM correction (2% in clean conditions), so verification of clinical records is still needed. No cost or latency was reported.
links.quote: GPT4oTranscribeCorrected was transcriptionally most accurate (DWER = 3.5%; WER = 3.7%), with DWER decreasing by 54.9% versus GPT4oTranscribe.

design_hint: LLM-based generative error correction of ASR transcripts
